- [OpenAI Halts Live Internet Training for Frontier AI Models](https://mikhbar.website/en/ai/openai-says-it-will-no-longer-train-its-ai-models-on-the/) (Artificial Intelligence · October 24, 2026) — OpenAI announces it will stop training its AI models on the live internet, using cached web content and sandboxed environments instead.
